summary: Mark Pennington, 71, of Prescott, AZ, overdue camper reported by son June 27; expected camping in Sherman area / upper Lake Fork; initial search failed to find his vehicle; wider search planned for June 28; located in Lake City via AFRCC cell-phone trace the morning of June 28.
responding_agency: Hinsdale County SAR, Hinsdale County Sheriff's Office, AFRCC
notes: Minor mission: Pennington had come into Lake City for supplies and returned to cell coverage; located by cell-phone trace, no field rescue needed. Date = located date.
